question: A school library received 51 boxes of donated books, and every box held exactly 3 books. The librarian sent 137 of these donated books across town to a partner school that had lost its collection in a flood. She then found that 3 more of them had water damage on the spine and set those aside for recycling. A week later a parent walked in with 12 further books for the same donation shelf. The library's catalogue records the donation shelf as single volumes rather than as whole shelf-sets. How many donated books does the library have on that shelf now?

On Monday morning a fruit stall opened with 40 ripe mangoes on the counter, and a neighbouring grower brought over 14 more before the first customers arrived. During the afternoon the owner cut every mango on the counter into 8 slices for his tasting bowls. By early evening 402 of those slices had been sold to passers-by, and a late delivery from the packing shed added another 34 slices to the bowls. Overnight the supplier tripled the number of slices ready for the next morning's market. How many slices are ready for the morning market?

A stationery shop counted 131 notebooks in its storeroom at the start of the month. 3 of them were ruined when a pipe leaked and were thrown away, then one delivery brought in 41 notebooks and a second delivery brought 76. The owner decided to send a shipment to each of the chain's 6 branches, and each shipment was to contain as many notebooks as the storeroom now held. The shop's delivery van makes 4 round trips a week. Stock is always recorded as single notebooks rather than as sealed cartons. How many notebooks were shipped to the branches altogether?

A community theatre printed 183 programme booklets for the opening night of its new play. Every booklet contains 5 pages, and every page carries 6 photographs of the cast. Each photograph is built up from 6 separate layers of coloured ink. The printing machine lays down 5 ink layers on each pass of its roller. The theatre's hall seats 400 people. How many passes of the roller were needed to print the whole run of booklets?

Marcus opened the growing season with 79 seedlings in his nursery. A supplier delivered 60 more in the first week, and his business partner Elena arrived with 72 seedlings of her own, which was more than the supplier had brought. Every seedling in the nursery was then used to grow 9 cuttings. A neighbouring farm donated 28 extra cuttings to the same bench, and later the nursery sold 567 cuttings to a garden centre. The potting shed can hold 15 trays at a time. How many cuttings are left at the nursery?

A bottling plant filled 211 crates of mineral water on one of its production lines on Monday. Each crate holds 6 boxes, and each box holds 4 bottles. Quality control found 3044 bottles with faulty seals and pulled every one of them off the line. Each bottle that remained was then decorated with 9 promotional stickers, and a leftover sheet from the previous week supplied a further 60 stickers to the same line's total. Everything described so far happened on just one line, and the plant's other lines matched it exactly, for 3 identical lines in all. How many promotional stickers did the plant use that Monday?

A pottery studio loaded 109 trays of tiles into the kiln, with 8 tiles resting on every tray. When the kiln was opened, 213 tiles had cracked in the heat and were thrown into the scrap bin. An apprentice fetched 21 sound tiles left over from an earlier firing, and a supplier delivered 30 more that afternoon. Every tile that was fit to use then received 5 coats of glaze. The studio keeps a dozen spare kiln shelves stacked in the back room. How many coats of glaze were painted in the studio that day?

A recycling depot took in 75 sacks of aluminium cans on Friday and another 68 sacks on Saturday. Every sack holds 9 bundles, and every bundle holds 9 cans. A primary school then dropped off 50 loose cans at the gate. The depot shipped 8818 cans to the smelter on Monday and a further 812 to a second buyer on Tuesday. The depot's ledger is kept in individual cans rather than in whole sacks. How many cans are still sitting at the depot?

A scout troop was given 192 embroidered badges by a retiring scoutmaster. The badges were divided equally among the troop's 6 patrols, and each patrol then divided its share equally among its 4 scouts. One scout, Nadia, already had 67 badges of her own at home, and she added the badges she had just been given to that collection. She sewed 34 of them onto a display banner for the hall and posted 4 to her cousin in another town. The troop hall has a dozen wooden benches along its walls. How many badges are left loose in Nadia's box?

Early on Saturday morning a market stall set out 44 jars of honey. The stallholder found 6 jars with cracked lids and took them off the table, and then a van from the apiary brought her 25 more. Through the late morning 40 jars were sold to shoppers, and at lunchtime a café owner bought 11 for his kitchen. In the afternoon she emptied every jar still on the table into 7 small sample cups each, and in the evening she added 25 sample cups she had filled the night before. The stall's price board lists everything in cents rather than in dollars. How many sample cups does she have by the end of the evening?

A hardware warehouse stores its stock of screws on 73 pallets. Each pallet carries 8 cartons, each carton holds 6 boxes, and each box contains 9 screws. Ahead of a large construction contract the owner tripled the number of screws held in the warehouse. A final delivery van then dropped off another 48 screws at the loading bay. How many screws are in the warehouse now?

A dance school had 165 costumes hanging in its storage room. A troupe that was closing down donated 76 more. The wardrobe manager found that 125 of the costumes were too moth-eaten to use and sent those to the tip, and a further 77 had been lent to a partner school years ago and were never returned. Every costume still on the rails was photographed from 9 angles for the online hire catalogue. The rehearsal hall has a dozen tall windows along one side. How many photographs went into the catalogue?

A vineyard was planted with 154 rows of vines, and there were 9 vines in every row. A late frost killed 1161 of the vines outright. The owner then pulled out another 200 vines that had shown signs of disease. Each vine that survived was trained onto 4 support wires along the trellis. The vineyard's records count individual vines rather than whole rows. How many support wires were used on the surviving vines?

Early on Saturday morning Daniel loaded 47 boxes of apples onto his roadside truck, and each box held 8 apples. By midday 258 apples had been sold to passing drivers. In the afternoon his sister Rosa took over and sliced every apple still on the truck into 7 pieces, which was more pieces per apple than Daniel had managed the previous week. In the early evening she dried each piece into 6 thin chips in the trailer's oven. Just before closing a neighbour arrived with 52 ready-made chips to add to the batch. How many chips did the pair have at the end of the day?

Nina and Omar run an invitation-printing stall at a craft fair. Nina fed 96 sheets of card through the press, and each sheet produced 6 invitations. A smudged stamp spoiled 198 of the invitations and they were binned. Omar then stuck 3 stickers onto every good invitation, more stickers per card than Nina had used at last year's fair. Overnight the damp air loosened 525 stickers and they fell off. The stall's stock list counts single stickers rather than full sheets. How many stickers are still attached to the invitations?

Amara baked 156 biscuits for a family gathering and packed them equally into 6 tins. She opened one tin and split the biscuits in it equally between herself and her brother Felix, who ended up with exactly as many as she did. Felix ate 7 of his biscuits straight away, and then their grandmother handed him 54 more from her own kitchen. He decided to press 6 chocolate chips into each of the biscuits he was holding, and every chip was made from 9 tiny cocoa flakes. The recipe card in the family folder lists weights in grams rather than kilograms. How many cocoa flakes were used on Felix's biscuits?

For the school summer fair, 119 gift bags were assembled on Thursday and 18 more on Friday. Each of the bags was filled with 6 sweets from the big tub in the staff room. A teacher then tipped 51 loose sweets into the same tub, and another class donated 66. During the fair itself 592 sweets were handed out to visitors from that tub. The hall has 240 chairs stacked along the back wall. How many sweets are left in the tub?

Sara and Diego build model bridges at their engineering club. Sara's box held 58 wooden rods to start with, she bought 50 more from the craft shop, and Diego handed her 60, which was more than she had bought herself. Each rod in the box can be cut into 5 short pegs for the joints. The club then packed all the pegs equally into 4 storage boxes. The club's inventory is written up in single pegs rather than in full boxes. How many pegs are in one storage box?

Ines gathered 95 walnuts from the tree at the end of the lane, and her brother Rafael added 40 that he had picked, fewer than Ines had found. They tipped them all together and shared them equally among 5 cloth bags. Ines took one bag home and cracked every walnut in it into 4 pieces. She threw away 11 pieces that had gone mouldy inside the shell. Each remaining piece was then chopped into 4 crumbs for a cake topping. How many crumbs did Ines end up with?

Sofia counted 196 pallets of floor tiles in the warehouse, with 4 crates stacked on every pallet, 8 packs in each crate, and 3 tiles in each pack. Her colleague Bruno carried in 77 loose tiles from the sample room, a far smaller number than Sofia had counted on the pallets. A builder's order then took 11180 tiles out of the warehouse on lorries. The warehouse forklift can lift 900 kilograms at a time. How many tiles are still in the warehouse?

Yusuf brought 131 conkers to school and gave 113 of them away during morning break. He split the conkers he still had equally among 3 friends. One of those friends, Mira, split her share equally among her 3 younger cousins, so she handed out fewer conkers to each cousin than Yusuf had given to each friend. The youngest cousin already kept 58 conkers of her own in a tin and added her share to them. She then threaded every conker in the tin onto a string with 7 glass beads beside it. How many glass beads did the youngest cousin use?

Early one morning Ana counted 196 sacks of rice in the relief depot, and every sack holds 9 bags. In the late morning her colleague Bruno, who counts more slowly than Ana does, weighed the bags and found that each bag fills 8 cups. During the afternoon the kitchen staff measured that each cup of rice fills 4 small bowls. In the evening the head cook worked out that each bowl feeds 5 children at the shelter. How many children can the depot's rice feed?

Omar's paving yard held 229 pallets of stones, with 5 stones on every pallet. A hard frost cracked 1018 of the stones and they were broken up for hardcore. Every stone that survived was bedded down with 9 dabs of mortar by his apprentice Lena, who lays stones more slowly than Omar does, and a leftover bucket gave her 51 extra dabs along the edging. Each dab of mortar takes 9 grams of cement. A dozen seagulls circled the yard all afternoon. How many grams of cement went into the job?

Nadia poured 119 soap moulds one morning, and each mould produced 6 bars. She added 30 bars left over from an earlier batch to the same crate. Her partner Karl, who pours fewer moulds each week than Nadia, wrapped every bar in the crate in 3 sheets of tissue paper, and a spare roll gave him 68 extra sheets for the shop display. Each sheet of tissue was then stamped with 3 gold logos, and a printer's sample sheet added 52 more logos to the day's count. How many gold logos were counted that day?

On Saturday morning a stationery van was loaded with 142 packs of pens, and each pack contained 4 pens. Before noon a leaking bottle of ink ruined 43 of the pens. In the afternoon 183 pens were dropped off at a school on the ring road. In the evening the driver Nia and her helper Ben divided the pens still in the van equally among 3 corner shops, with Ben carrying more of the boxes inside than Nia did. How many pens did one corner shop receive?
